performance_claim: NONE — data is a validation slice; no edge is claimed.
positioning: CHAMPION V2 / ALL-IN PREGAME TOTALS (Leon, 2026-07-07): the board's PICK PRODUCT is the champion_v2 stream below — the champion's own live totals engine + the +EV/vig gate at the REAL latest per-side price (a priced-out champion pick renders as PASS, never a bet), champion-edge star tiers (4-star ceiling). The v4 model grid is TOTALS-ONLY (spread/ML surfaces removed); it remains star-capped by walk evidence with -EV a hard PASS. NOT the champion's pregame_picks Supabase path; the champion engine continues untouched — V2 only reads its stores. Keep the honest record prominent.

champion_v2.what: CHAMPION V2 — the board's pick product: the champion's own live totals engine (unchanged) + V4 serving discipline (+EV/vig gate at the real latest per-side price, star tiers by the champion's own edge size, nightly grading). PREGAME TOTALS ONLY.
champion_v2.star_basis: Stars are driven by the CHAMPION'S OWN edge size + tier: Tier A with |model-vs-market| >= 0.05 (big divergence) = 4 stars; Tier A 0.03-0.05 = 3 stars; Tier B (0.02-0.03) = 2 stars. CEILING 4 stars — the champion has a live/validated forward record (rolling-origin 2022-2026: 886 graded, hit 58.1%, ROI +10.8% at median price) but is NOT BH-certified on the v4 sealed walk, and its edge did not reproduce on the Odds-API table (the dev-null), so 5 stars stays reserved. FLOOR = the +EV/vig gate at the REAL latest per-side price: a priced-out champion pick is a PASS (0 stars), shown honestly, never a bet.
model_notes: DEV-NULL (2026-07-07, v4/models/UNIFIED_TOTALS.md): the champion's edge does NOT reproduce when re-derived on the Odds-API 5-DP odds table — the champion-style path graded flat (+0.1% on 283 dev picks, 2022-25) and the V4 GBM residual path was actively anti-signal at high divergence (-16.6%). CHAMPION V2 therefore uses the champion's OWN pipeline (its snapshot stack + frozen model + frozen policy) as the pick source; V4 adds serving-time discipline (+EV gate at the real latest per-side price, star tiers, nightly grading) — it does NOT re-derive the signal.

HABITAT EROSION WARNING: the champion's trigger habitat — cross-book totals dispersion — is structurally shrinking: T-3h line_std 0.126 (2023) -> 0.096 (2024) -> 0.083 (2025) -> 0.076 (2026); share of slates with >=2 distinct lines 67% -> 48% -> 43% -> 39%; books quoted 16.7 -> 11.7 -> 10.9 -> 11.0. Expect fewer qualifying picks over time. The record display is the ongoing proof either way — no edge is presumed.

gated_out.note: champion picks the +EV gate EXCLUDED at the real per-side price (shown as PASS-priced-out on the board, never bet); their would-have record is informational only. would_have_record covers ONLY the n_graded rows with a win/loss/push result; n_pending_or_no_result rows are counted here explicitly and excluded from the counterfactual record — never silently dropped.

record.basis: Headline record = the CHAMPION V2 stream exactly: champion picks that passed the +EV gate at the stored real per-side price, graded at that same price. 2026 backfill = rolling-origin stream (2026-03-27..06-10, Tier A, median morning per-side price) + the live forward paper track (2026-07-02 onward, frozen morning price); gap 2026-06-11..07-01 not reconstructable (game DB frozen 06-13; forward track started 07-02) and is simply absent — nothing is interpolated. Live picks accrue nightly at the latest-snapshot price they were served at.

rolling_origin_2026.what: champion's own rolling-origin (expanding, 14-day retrain) 2026 stream, Tier A trigger, stored median morning per-side prices — bets_expanding.parquet

forward_paper_ledger.what: the live value-plays paper track (value_plays_ledger.json), Tier A + Tier B, stored frozen morning price

backfill.coverage_gap: 2026-06-11 .. 2026-07-01 NOT reconstructable (game DB frozen 2026-06-13; forward track began 2026-07-02) — absent, not interpolated

slate_status.note: 0 plays = the champion's own frozen policy found no qualifying totals divergence today (or its internal gates suppressed the candidates) — an empty board is honest, not broken

star_basis.note: STAR CAPS from the last completed walk: a live +EV take in an unproven cell (fails baselines or thin n) emits at max 2 stars as 'Lean (unproven cell)'; a one-sided cell caps at 1 star (flagged); >=3 stars requires a baseline-beating cell; 5 stars additionally requires BH significance. -EV never emits (unchanged hard gate).
